slides.texte_overlay:
10 sentences that will make
you sit and rethink it all

1. Somewhere, an old friend
still tells a story about you
that makes people laugh.

2. Your father was once
your age, just as lost,
pretending he had a plan.

3. The night you think
will never end has an
ending you'll barely remember.

4. There's a song you
haven't heard yet that will
become the soundtrack of
your best year.

5. There's an idea you'll
learn this year that will
change how you see
everything after it.
slides.texte_sophia:
5. There's an idea you'll
learn this year, maybe in
5 minutes on the Sophia app,
that will change how you see
everything after it.

slides.texte_overlay:
6. Someone is grateful
for something you said
and forgot the next day.

7. The bed you'll wake up in
ten years from now
is being decided by
what you do this week.

8. Every mile you ran
when nobody watched
is still in your legs.

9. The place you dream
about living already exists,
and it's waiting.

10. The man you'll be at 40
is watching you right now,
hoping you don't quit.
